rules: Use bold weights (700, 900) for structural clarity and hierarchy.
Use IBM Plex Mono for all cognitive process labels, technical tags, and JSON output.
Never use Inter for headings. Ensure a scientific, rigorous tone.
Apply tight tracking (`tracking-tight`) for headings over 32px.
Use uppercase with wide tracking (`tracking-widest`) for overlines and structural section headers.
No gradients. Flat solid backgrounds to maintain functional, academic clarity.
Use High contrast text ONLY. Never use gray-on-gray for critical cognitive data.
Accent colors are strictly functional (e.g., Red for 'Tipos de erro', Green for 'Competências', Blue for primary actions).

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton. Data-heavy tables and JSON visualizers need visible structural lines.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E4E4E7 on all structural elements. Use `border-collapse` style layout where possible.
visual_enhancers.shadows: None or extremely subtle `shadow-sm`. Rely on 1px borders and stark contrast rather than soft shadows.
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Sharp, instantaneous state changes. Hover states darken the background slightly.

layouts.spacing: Dense but structured. Use `p-4` to `p-6` for data cards. Use `p-8` for page padding.
layouts.grid: High Density Grid (For Dashboards/Analytics). `grid-cols-1` mobile to `grid-cols-12` desktop system.
layouts.navigation: Left sidebar, rigid 1px border right. Solid background (`bg-white`).
patterns: Split View for Pipeline: Left side (Question content, PDF/Img preview - 5 cols), Right side (Cognitive JSON & Tags - 7 cols).
Collapsible Trees for Ontology: Use indented borders and clean vertical lines to show hierarchy.

libraries: shadcn/ui (Accordions, Cards, Badges, Tabs, Dialogs, Dropdowns)
customizations: Cards: Go cardless or use sharp 0px/2px radius with 1px borders.
Badges: Square or 2px radius, use monochromatic scale + 1 accent color.
Use Shadcn Dropdown, Calendar, Tabs, etc., but override default rounded corners with `rounded-sm` or `rounded-none`.

rules: Avoid large sweeping animations. The tool must feel like a fast, rigorous scientific instrument.

accessibility.contrast: Strict APCA/WCAG AA compliance. Dark text on light backgrounds.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.

image_urls.description: Architectural grid/structure, useful for subtle empty state or welcome screen.

rules: Minimal image usage. Prioritize raw data, text layout, and structural hierarchy.
No placeholder images. Use functional empty state text and icons instead.

GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Navigation must be visible on desktop (Sidebar).
Provide clear, color-coded tags for cognitive data (Domínios Cognitivos, Competências, Processos Cognitivos, Tipos de erro).
Make JSON outputs clearly readable with syntax highlighting.
Implement 'Explicabilidade' by allowing users to click 'Mostrar justificativa' on cognitive processes to reveal an expandable panel or tooltip with the exact logic.
Do not use complete transparent background in headers, overlays, or dropdowns.
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a Left Sidebar with Navigation to: Dashboard (Home), Ontologia Cognitiva, Gerador de Pipeline, Questões Processadas.

For the 'Ontologia Cognitiva' page, build a deep collapsible hierarchy visualization (8 Domains, 16 Competencies, etc.) using Shadcn Accordion or Collapsible. Include stats (import date, version, counts).

For the 'Gerador de Pipeline' page, build a complex layout: file upload area, and upon generation, display the question context alongside a detailed cognitive pipeline output (Tags + Justifications + raw JSON block). Add action buttons (Export, Copy, Validate JSON).
For 'Questões Processadas', build a functional data table with robust filtering (discipline, year, process, etc.).
Avoid typical generic SaaS styling. Use square corners (0px to 4px max) to reinforce the scientific/academic feel.
Provide design rules for `.js` and `.jsx` files, not `.tsx`, as the repository uses JavaScript.
Always use `data-testid` for buttons, inputs, and key data points.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, using borders and stark contrasts instead of deep shadows.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (`transition: all`).
You MUST NOT center align the app container in CSS.
Use modern button styles relevant to the app style (in this case, sharp/brutalist technical buttons).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💡) for icons. Use clean Lucide icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover, focus states).
Ensure all dropdowns and overlay backgrounds are solid (e.g., `bg-white`), never transparent.
